name: GridPathfinder
src_typeComment: Standalone A* pathfinder over a GridComponent's cells — kept as its own component on purpose, so you only pay for pathfinding if you actually add it, and it can be swapped for a different algorithm later without touching GridComponent or GridPlacer.

src_serialized.name: allowDiagonals
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, diagonal movement between cells is allowed. Independent of the grid's own AllowDiagonalNeighbors — the grid can display/support diagonal adjacency for other tools while pathfinding still searches 4-directionally, or vice versa.

src_serialized.name: preventCornerCutting
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, a diagonal move is blocked when either of the two orthogonal cells it passes between is blocked — prevents the path from squeezing through a wall corner.

src_members.name: IsWalkableOverride
src_members.comment: A cell is walkable if it has no object occupying it in grid.Occupancy. Assign this if you need custom rules instead (terrain cost, locked cells, etc.) — leave null to use the default check.

src_members.sig: public List<Vector3> FindPath(Vector3 startWorld, Vector3 endWorld)
src_members.name: FindPath
src_members.comment: Returns a path of world-space cell centers from start to end, or an empty list if no path exists.
